urdu: محمد علی جناح نے 3 جون 1947 کے اعلان کے دوران اپنے خطاب کا اختتام کس نعرے سے کیا؟
english: With which slogan did Muhammad Ali Jinnah conclude his speech during the announcement on June 3, 1947?
roman_1: Muhammad Ali Jinnah ne 3 June 1947 ke ilan ke doran apne khitab ka ikhtitam kis nare se kiya?
roman_2: Mohammad Ali Jinnah ne 3 June 1947 k ilan k doran apnay khitab ka ikhtitam kis nare se kiya?
roman_3: Mohammad Ali Jinnah nay 3 June 1947 ke ilan ke doran apnay khitab ka ikhtitam kis nare se kiya?
